# Untrusted Network — [MODE-ZERO]

> Untrusted Network is an independent game studio developing **[MODE-ZERO]**, a side-on cyberpunk platformer for PC set in Nullgrid, a single unbroken city that Keystone built and Overwatch watches.

## Project overview

- **Title:** `[MODE-ZERO]` (the square brackets are part of the name)
- **Studio:** Untrusted Network (`https://untrustednetwork.dev/`)
- **Tagline:** Move. Evade. Hack.
- **Genre:** Side-on cyberpunk platformer
- **Platform:** PC (in development)
- **Premise:** You gave Keystone ten years and left with a datapad and a service award. Now you work Nullgrid alone, with Overwatch's red eye on every street.

## The world of Nullgrid

- **Keystone ("Connecting Worlds"):** The conglomerate that makes the pad in your hand, the system it boots on and the interface in your head. All of it stays connected. You accepted the terms.
- **Overwatch:** Runs every camera in Nullgrid, and its red eye is on every street. It records where you go, who you meet and what you carry. The people it takes are driven to Sector 0, and their names leave the public record. Its drones include the Tracker, the Response interceptor and the heavy Patrol.
- **Nullgrid Civic Works:** Flies the amber municipal scrubber drones that clean graffiti off the walls of Lower Streets.
- **Nullgrid:** A single unbroken city. Red Sector burns with neon, cranes swing over the Data Docks, and the towers of Corporate Spire stand in glass and gold, Keystone's the tallest of all.
- **Street marks:** The city's walls carry the marks of its syndicates and crews:
  - **OFFBOOK** — a ledger struck through.
  - **CRIMSON ROW** — three chevrons.
  - **STACKRUNNERS** — stacked floors, one way up.
  - **GRIDROT** — a grid with the pieces missing.
  - **INTERCEPT** — pirate broadcasters: "The air is not theirs."

## The street on the home page

The top of `https://untrustednetwork.dev/` is a live slice of Lower Streets, drawn in the browser with ports of the game's own art and music code. Nothing is labelled; things answer when you try them.

- **Move:** A/D or the arrow keys to run, W, Up or Space to jump, E to use what you are standing by (or sit on a bench), F to spray a mark on the wall. Left alone, the operator wanders the street.
- **Click:** the operator (changes their colour, and the skyline's windows with it), the companion drone (a scanner pulse), the Overwatch camera (shorts it out for a while), an Overwatch drone or the scrubber drone (paint over its lens), a bare wall (a street mark), streetlights, vending machines, bins, the hydrant, trees, the Pixel Arcade's door (its chip tune) and the comm booth (Keystone's support line, and its hold music).
- **Heat:** Standing in a camera's or drone's view raises the heat meter, and Overwatch's layers come into the music.
- **Sound:** Off until the visitor turns it on. All of it is synthesised live in the browser; the site loads no audio files.

## Launch alert

Visitors can leave an email address at `https://untrustednetwork.dev/#wishlist` for one message from `modezero@untrustednetwork.dev` when the Steam page and release build go live.
